name: WPD Total Care – Security & Enhancements
author: WP Division

sections.description:
WPD Total Care simplifies your WordPress management by consolidating essential features like security, site enhancements and performance into a single, user-friendly plugin. This eliminates the need for multiple plugins, reducing conflicts, improving performance, and streamlining your workflow.

Key Features:

Optimize WordPress Core:

  • Configure AutoSave intervals.
  • Enable/disable WordPress revisions.
  • Limit revisions number.
  • Media Trash control.
  • Adjust memory limits for improved performance.
  • Enhance security by hiding your WordPress version, disabling directory listing, and controlling error reporting.
  • Protect core WordPress files and directories from unauthorized access.

Author Security:

  • Prevent user enumeration for enhanced security.
  • Disable “List Users” functionality.
  • Customize author slugs and base URLs for better control.
sections.installation:
Installing the WPD Total Care Plugin

Method 1: Direct Installation from the WordPress Admin Panel

  1. In the WordPress admin menu, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “WPD Total Care”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. The WPD Total Care menu item will now be available in your main WordPress admin menu.

Method 2: Manual Upload and Installation

  1. Download the WPD Total Care plugin .zip file.
  2. Upload the .zip file to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory on your server (via FTP, SFTP, or your hosting control panel\’s file manager).
  3. In the main WordPress admin menu, go to Plugins.
  4. Activate the WPD Total Care plugin.
  5. The WPD Total Care menu item will now be available in your main WordPress admin menu.

Method 3: Upload via the WordPress Admin Panel

  1. Download the WPD Total Care plugin .zip file.
  2. In the main WordPress admin menu, go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin at the top of the page.
  4. Choose the downloaded .zip file and click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate.
  6. The WPD Total Care menu item will now be available in your main WordPress admin menu.
